Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.logout

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.logout
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web
    Web adapter of the authorization server: security filter chains, login page and OpenAPI description.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    LogoutChainCustomizer
    Configures how a user signs out of the login/UI chain: a POST to "/logout" (protected by CSRF, so a third-party page cannot sign the user out) invalidates the session, deletes its cookie and returns to the login page.
    LogoutController
    Serves the page that asks the user to confirm signing out, as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes it through the generated LogoutPageApi.
